source: counter strike but without gravity. the map is 3D with parts that go up and down in xyz coordinate space, not just 2D or 2D with elevation changes. everything else is the same as CS. start with making everything simple polygon. don't worry about backends or multiplayer. make it first person view if possible. put enemies in random places. enemies have HP. you can shoot them and kill them. when an enemy is killed. they respawn.

image_prompt.text: Waist-high and full-body cover on every route, built from the same simple polygon blocks as the rest of the map
Narrow transitions where routes meet, in three dimensions rather than only on the ground plane
An open bomb site with clear approaches to attack and hold
Bases at opposite ends of the map, shielded from long sightlines
Blocks, platforms, corridors and rooms placed at different heights and offsets through the whole XYZ volume, not a floor plan with elevation on top
Everything built from plain untextured polygons

layout_placement.text: The bomb site as a held or contested point
Opposing base spawns at opposite ends
Enemies placed at random positions throughout the volume, with health, respawning where they died

notes: The defining request - a play space that is genuinely volumetric because there is no gravity - has no expression in the Shooter shape table. The volumetric play-space axis and its CHECK route exist only in no-genre.md, so CHECK cannot be reached from a genre-classified prompt. It should be raised here: a play volume this deep will self-occlude in a single top-down.
Bomb Defusal preset taken whole because the prompt says everything except gravity is the same as Counter-Strike. spawn-teambase is kept but contradicted - see preset_rejected.
Zero gravity is a physics rule over the whole build, not a layout feature, and nothing in the handoff carries it downstream.

open_questions.ask: How deep should the volume be vertically - is up and down as big as across?
With no multiplayer and respawning bots, is there a round or a bomb at all, or is it just shooting targets?

theme: Untextured greybox - simple polygons, no set dressing

coverage_missing.ask: How large is the volume, and is the vertical extent comparable to the horizontal?
Is there still a bomb round, or is the goal just killing bots?

answers.ask: How deep should the volume be vertically - is up and down as big as across?
answers.answer: Make the vertical depth roughly as large as the map's width and length, so it is a true cubic 3D combat space rather than a flat arena.

answers.ask: With no multiplayer and respawning bots, is there a round or a bomb at all, or is it just shooting targets?
answers.answer: It is just a simple first-person shooting target arena: no rounds, bomb, or other Counter-Strike objectives; bots respawn after being killed.
